domain: analysis workflow: comparing defect causes across manufacturing shifts
epistemic_status: Synthetic proposals only. No production records, measured defect rates, or causal findings are provided.

case.valued_outcome: Distinguish material-lot and shift-process explanations for a defect pattern.
resources: Hypothetical shift-level summaries and lot labels
No additional sampling budget is supplied

raw_candidates.claim: A lot-by-shift comparison may distinguish the competing explanations when crossed records exist.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: A lot account predicts persistence across shifts; a process account predicts persistence across lots within the implicated shift.
raw_candidates.discriminator: Comparable crossed cells with the opposite pattern defeat each prediction. If coverage is confounded, the table cannot discriminate.
raw_candidates.probe: Proposed only: inspect coverage and anonymous summaries, retaining absent cells as absent.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Discrimination depends on unknown coverage; the workflow can report non-identifiability while preserving constraints.

raw_candidates.claim: Collecting new crossed samples could reduce lot-shift confounding.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: Deliberately crossed observations are predicted to expose differences hidden by existing assignments.
raw_candidates.discriminator: It predicts better separability, not a particular winning cause. Continued inseparability defeats its proposed advantage.
raw_candidates.probe: Proposed only after explicitly relaxing existing-records-only and obtaining a sampling resource.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Requires a stated hard-constraint relaxation; sampling access, expense, and discriminatory yield are also unknown.

raw_candidates.claim: Imputing empty cells might produce a complete comparison matrix.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: Model assumptions would generate estimates where observations are absent.
raw_candidates.discriminator: Rejected because missing values must remain unimputed. A complete-looking matrix would not itself defeat confounding.
raw_candidates.probe: Parked; no imputation is proposed for execution.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Bias introduced by imputation and stability of any ranking remain unknown.
